question: Will any North American country have a CDC travel advisory issued in October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Not yet resolved: as of Oct 11 the CDC THN page lists no North American notice newly issued in October (the only October item is the Global Dengue update on Oct 2). Base rate: roughly 5-7 of the last 13 months had a new North American notice (Cuba chikungunya Sep 2025, Mexico RMSF Dec 2025, Canada HepA Jun 2026, Haiti diphtheria Jun 2026, Nicaragua chikungunya Aug 2026, Costa Rica HepA Sep 18 2026), about 45% per month, and June-September 2026 has been busier. About 35% of the month is gone, so roughly 20 days remain. Counting only 'New' notices, not 'Updated' ones. No market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- CDC THN page fetched 2026-10-11: no notice for a North American country marked New with an October 2026 date. October entries: Global Dengue Level 1 updated Oct 2, 2026 (lists Costa Rica, Cuba, Panama among others; global notice, an update).
- North American notices currently listed (CDC THN page, 2026-10-11): Chikungunya in Nicaragua L2 (New Aug 3, Updated Sep 3, 2026); Chikungunya in Costa Rica L2 (Updated Jul 30, 2026); Hepatitis A in Costa Rica L1 (New Sep 18, 2026); Diphtheria in Haiti L1 (New Jun 25, 2026); Hepatitis A in Canada L1 (New Jun 4, 2026); Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mexico L1 (Dec 23, 2025); Global Measles (May 28, 2025).
- Earlier North American notices found via search: Chikungunya in Cuba L2 (Sep 26, 2025); Oropouche in the Americas incl. Cuba (Sep 18, 2025); US Embassy Havana health alert Sep 29, 2025.
- Count over the last ~13 months (Sep 2025-Sep 2026): months with at least one new North American country notice were Sep 2025, Dec 2025, Jun 2026, Aug 2026 and Sep 2026, with Jul 2026 uncertain (Costa Rica chikungunya creation date not found). That is about 5-6 of 13 months. Notices since retired from the page may be missing from this count.
- Rate conditional on the recent regime: June-September 2026, 4 of 4 months had a new North American notice.
- Status quo: no new North American notice in October so far.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off the CDC THN page (wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices) and a notice NEWLY issued in October 2026; the question background treats 'new' as distinct from 'updated' (it cites Nicaragua Aug 3 as the most recent new one).
- Event window: 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-31 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-11T06:00Z about 33% has elapsed.
- Searched but not found: a full web-archive history of notices (web.archive.org blocked); any Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market; news of an imminent new outbreak in Mexico, Central America or the Caribbean in October 2026.

In mid-2026 new NA notices came about monthly (Jun: Canada HepA, Haiti diphtheria; Jul 30: Costa Rica chik; Aug 3: Nicaragua chik; Sep 18: Costa Rica HepA), and older ones were sparser (Mexico RMSF Dec 2025). With ~65% of October left, a Poisson rate of ~0.6-0.8 a month gives ~35%. Candidates: Cuba's dengue surge (but dengue is handled by a global notice) and chikungunya spread. No human market found.

calls.reasoning: As of Oct 11 the CDC THN page shows no newly issued North American country notice in October; only the Oct 2 Global Dengue update, which is global and an update, so almost certainly doesn't count. Recent regime (Jun-Sep 2026) had about 5 new NA notices in 4 months; the longer-run rate looks nearer 0.5 a month (Sep 2025, Dec 2025; Jan-May 2026 unverified). Blending to about 0.8 a month over the remaining ~20/31 days gives about 40%. Active drivers (Cuba dengue/chikungunya, chik spread into Guatemala/Honduras, Costa Rica HepA) support the rate; CDC's use of a global dengue notice caps it. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the factual state: as of Oct 11 the THN page shows no new NA notice in October, and the only October entry is the Global Dengue update. Unsettled factual items: whether Costa Rica chikungunya (Jul 30) was new or an update, and the Jan-May 2026 count, which no run could verify (archive blocked). Neither can be settled without web access. The core dispute is a judgment about how much to weight the busy Jun-Sep regime against the sparser longer record. I took about 0.8 a month, which over ~20 days gives about 40%. Small extra mass for possible lenient counting of updates.
